what: Photo pieces scattered on the panel bloom in shuffled order, staggered by .08 each, over .9s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1) once the panel top edge reaches 72% of the screen — they grow from .1x (data-scale=false keeps the size) pieces slide in 64px from the left or right up to their own opacity (data-opacity). While the panel passes, each piece drifts up 140~320px in proportion to its width (48~110px on narrow screens) and the center text drifts 72px (28px on narrow screens) (scrub .55). Following the mouse, each piece sways separately by strength (data-mouse) × 14px with .85s power3.out, creating depth.

options.shift: Distance sliding in from the side (px), default 64
options.min · max: Distance (px) the smallest · largest pieces travel on wide screens, default 140 · 320 (narrow screens min-narrow · max-narrow 48 · 110)
options.content: Distance the center text travels (px), default 72
options.mouse: Default mouse sway width (px), default 14 — 0 turns it off
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Piece — placement is set by the user via style (top · left · width · z-index). data-reveal-from (center · left · right) · data-scale (size stays as is when false) · data-opacity (end opacity) · data-mouse (sway strength). The first child blooms and drifts
